{"blocks":[{"block_id":"M050-SRC-AUTHORIAL-GRAMMAR-001__B00367_3808e2c1857e","block_type":"heading","status_markers":[],"structural_disposition":"context_only","text":"# IX. Defined Text Treatments
"},{"block_id":"M050-SRC-AUTHORIAL-GRAMMAR-001__B00369_095b0f509018","block_type":"heading","status_markers":[],"structural_disposition":"context_only","text":"## 1. Typography must carry a stable function
"},{"block_id":"M050-SRC-AUTHORIAL-GRAMMAR-001__B00371_a9237cdfaa6e","block_type":"paragraph","status_markers":[],"structural_disposition":"eligible","text":"Italics, bold text, small caps, inset prose, rule boxes, and other treatments should not acquire semantic meaning casually.
"},{"block_id":"M050-SRC-AUTHORIAL-GRAMMAR-001__B00373_4b85060a770e","block_type":"paragraph","status_markers":[],"structural_disposition":"eligible","text":"A treatment becomes authorial grammar only when it has:
"},{"block_id":"M050-SRC-AUTHORIAL-GRAMMAR-001__B00375_3a8ca338044d","block_type":"list_item","status_markers":[],"structural_disposition":"eligible","text":"- a stable function;
"},{"block_id":"M050-SRC-AUTHORIAL-GRAMMAR-001__B00376_46948927540b","block_type":"list_item","status_markers":[],"structural_disposition":"eligible","text":"- repeated use;
"},{"block_id":"M050-SRC-AUTHORIAL-GRAMMAR-001__B00377_b3bd214a6cc9","block_type":"list_item","status_markers":[],"structural_disposition":"eligible","text":"- clear distinction from ordinary emphasis;
"},{"block_id":"M050-SRC-AUTHORIAL-GRAMMAR-001__B00378_4f5955727736","block_type":"list_item","status_markers":[],"structural_disposition":"eligible","text":"- value across multiple sections;
"},{"block_id":"M050-SRC-AUTHORIAL-GRAMMAR-001__B00379_b6b727dde8ed","block_type":"list_item","status_markers":[],"structural_disposition":"eligible","text":"- and practical compatibility with writing, editing, layout, and automated checking.
"},{"block_id":"M050-SRC-AUTHORIAL-GRAMMAR-001__B00381_6ddd75d470de","block_type":"heading","status_markers":[],"structural_disposition":"context_only","text":"## 2. Current provisional convention
"},{"block_id":"M050-SRC-AUTHORIAL-GRAMMAR-001__B00383_f0aa28ed139a","block_type":"code_fence","status_markers":["status: PROVISIONAL"],"structural_disposition":"eligible","text":"```yaml
convention: mechanics_teaching_narrative
display_form: italics
status: PROVISIONAL
meaning: >
  A brief in-world Narrative passage that teaches, demonstrates, or reframes
  a mechanic without switching into direct specification voice.
```
"},{"block_id":"M050-SRC-AUTHORIAL-GRAMMAR-001__B00385_8596b59069f5","block_type":"paragraph","status_markers":[],"structural_disposition":"eligible","text":"Example:
"},{"block_id":"M050-SRC-AUTHORIAL-GRAMMAR-001__B00387_f6fc000fc5f6","block_type":"paragraph","status_markers":[],"structural_disposition":"eligible","text":"> *Mouse does not cross empty ground. Mouse makes a road from every edge the body can still feel.*
"},{"block_id":"M050-SRC-AUTHORIAL-GRAMMAR-001__B00389_faac618fba12","block_type":"paragraph","status_markers":[],"structural_disposition":"eligible","text":"The italics signal a mechanics-teaching Narrative function, not merely emphasis.
"},{"block_id":"M050-SRC-AUTHORIAL-GRAMMAR-001__B00391_35c30c8ef947","block_type":"paragraph","status_markers":[],"structural_disposition":"eligible","text":"This convention remains provisional until repeated Sourcebook use proves that it is both legible and necessary.
"},{"block_id":"M050-SRC-AUTHORIAL-GRAMMAR-001__B00393_59ac0854d0dc","block_type":"heading","status_markers":[],"structural_disposition":"context_only","text":"## 3. Avoid competing uses
"},{"block_id":"M050-SRC-AUTHORIAL-GRAMMAR-001__B00395_5ac34474c4ac","block_type":"paragraph","status_markers":[],"structural_disposition":"eligible","text":"While a defined italic convention is active, do not also use italics indiscriminately for:
"},{"block_id":"M050-SRC-AUTHORIAL-GRAMMAR-001__B00397_d1f25d65c40d","block_type":"list_item","status_markers":[],"structural_disposition":"eligible","text":"- casual emphasis;
"},{"block_id":"M050-SRC-AUTHORIAL-GRAMMAR-001__B00398_aa4d1674d21a","block_type":"list_item","status_markers":[],"structural_disposition":"eligible","text":"- every in-world quotation;
"},{"block_id":"M050-SRC-AUTHORIAL-GRAMMAR-001__B00399_c5623301b8b3","block_type":"list_item","status_markers":[],"structural_disposition":"eligible","text":"- every Tale;
"},{"block_id":"M050-SRC-AUTHORIAL-GRAMMAR-001__B00400_a992bf11ebd8","block_type":"list_item","status_markers":[],"structural_disposition":"eligible","text":"- every foreign or invented word;
"},{"block_id":"M050-SRC-AUTHORIAL-GRAMMAR-001__B00401_1fa8a84ba273","block_type":"list_item","status_markers":[],"structural_disposition":"eligible","text":"- every caption.
"},{"block_id":"M050-SRC-AUTHORIAL-GRAMMAR-001__B00403_ae89bb9d544f","block_type":"paragraph","status_markers":[],"structural_disposition":"eligible","text":"Competing meanings weaken the grammar.
"},{"block_id":"M050-SRC-AUTHORIAL-GRAMMAR-001__B00407_a0e579eb484f","block_type":"heading","status_markers":[],"structural_disposition":"context_only","text":"# X. Emergent Grammar
"},{"block_id":"M050-SRC-AUTHORIAL-GRAMMAR-001__B00409_0223e4b739e4","block_type":"paragraph","status_markers":[],"structural_disposition":"eligible","text":"This guide is intentionally extensible.
"},{"block_id":"M050-SRC-AUTHORIAL-GRAMMAR-001__B00411_576e6bb4ed0c","block_type":"paragraph","status_markers":[],"structural_disposition":"eligible","text":"Authorial conventions often become visible only when substantial Sourcebook prose, Narrative, captions, diagrams, and appendix plates exist. New conventions may therefore be recorded without pretending they were known at project inception.
"},{"block_id":"M050-SRC-AUTHORIAL-GRAMMAR-001__B00413_afb351d884f3","block_type":"heading","status_markers":[],"structural_disposition":"context_only","text":"## 1. Convention statuses
"},{"block_id":"M050-SRC-AUTHORIAL-GRAMMAR-001__B00415_22a6ed00966a","block_type":"table_row","status_markers":[],"structural_disposition":"eligible","text":"| Status | Meaning |
"},{"block_id":"M050-SRC-AUTHORIAL-GRAMMAR-001__B00416_ac92d1b091b2","block_type":"table_row","status_markers":[],"structural_disposition":"eligible","text":"|---|---|
"},{"block_id":"M050-SRC-AUTHORIAL-GRAMMAR-001__B00417_3d05a7fa71cd","block_type":"table_row","status_markers":[],"structural_disposition":"eligible","text":"| `OBSERVED` | A recurring pattern has appeared but has not been intentionally adopted. |
"},{"block_id":"M050-SRC-AUTHORIAL-GRAMMAR-001__B00418_6c75f2938fe0","block_type":"table_row","status_markers":[],"structural_disposition":"eligible","text":"| `PROVISIONAL` | The pattern is being used deliberately and tested for stability. |
"},{"block_id":"M050-SRC-AUTHORIAL-GRAMMAR-001__B00419_d2d83d27439b","block_type":"table_row","status_markers":[],"structural_disposition":"eligible","text":"| `SETTLED` | The pattern has a defined function and is the required house form. |
"},{"block_id":"M050-SRC-AUTHORIAL-GRAMMAR-001__B00420_6238a28e8e64","block_type":"table_row","status_markers":[],"structural_disposition":"eligible","text":"| `RETIRED` | The pattern was tested and removed from current authorial grammar. |
"},{"block_id":"M050-SRC-AUTHORIAL-GRAMMAR-001__B00422_87b21645516e","block_type":"heading","status_markers":[],"structural_disposition":"context_only","text":"## 2. Promotion test
"},{"block_id":"M050-SRC-AUTHORIAL-GRAMMAR-001__B00424_81e51794a522","block_type":"paragraph","status_markers":[],"structural_disposition":"eligible","text":"A convention may move from `OBSERVED` or `PROVISIONAL` to `SETTLED` only when:
"},{"block_id":"M050-SRC-AUTHORIAL-GRAMMAR-001__B00426_5b855cfd33e8","block_type":"list_item","status_markers":[],"structural_disposition":"eligible","text":"1. its semantic function can be stated in one sentence;
"},{"block_id":"M050-SRC-AUTHORIAL-GRAMMAR-001__B00427_83aa2fb85b56","block_type":"list_item","status_markers":[],"structural_disposition":"eligible","text":"2. it does not duplicate another established treatment;
"},{"block_id":"M050-SRC-AUTHORIAL-GRAMMAR-001__B00428_e1d3385113e5","block_type":"list_item","status_markers":[],"structural_disposition":"eligible","text":"3. authors can apply it consistently;
"},{"block_id":"M050-SRC-AUTHORIAL-GRAMMAR-001__B00429_b5f20c77d3f8","block_type":"list_item","status_markers":[],"structural_disposition":"eligible","text":"4. readers can distinguish it;
"},{"block_id":"M050-SRC-AUTHORIAL-GRAMMAR-001__B00430_9600c5fe3d94","block_type":"list_item","status_markers":[],"structural_disposition":"eligible","text":"5. it survives conversion between Markdown, layout, and Phonebook presentation;
"},{"block_id":"M050-SRC-AUTHORIAL-GRAMMAR-001__B00431_1f1bc92c55e3","block_type":"list_item","status_markers":[],"structural_disposition":"eligible","text":"6. automated linting can identify at least its obvious violations;
"},{"block_id":"M050-SRC-AUTHORIAL-GRAMMAR-001__B00432_e98db71bc79c","block_type":"list_item","status_markers":[],"structural_disposition":"eligible","text":"7. an explicit human ruling adopts it.
"},{"block_id":"M050-SRC-AUTHORIAL-GRAMMAR-001__B00434_a5ebbe8fcf4b","block_type":"heading","status_markers":[],"structural_disposition":"context_only","text":"## 3. Grammar log
"},{"block_id":"M050-SRC-AUTHORIAL-GRAMMAR-001__B00436_886a10e2247f","block_type":"paragraph","status_markers":[],"structural_disposition":"eligible","text":"Future revisions should maintain a compact convention ledger:
"},{"block_id":"M050-SRC-AUTHORIAL-GRAMMAR-001__B00438_d8ab4078552b","block_type":"code_fence","status_markers":[],"structural_disposition":"context_only","text":"```yaml
canonical_name:
status:
written_form:
semantic_function:
first_observed:
adopted_by:
conflicts_with:
phonebook_expression:
```
"}],"ordinal_range":[367,441],"pilot_id":"M050-AUTHGRAM-PILOT-002","schema_version":"M050-PILOT-PAYLOAD-0.1","source_id":"M050-SRC-AUTHORIAL-GRAMMAR-001","source_sha256":"7d23ef2ccbff0c6594975c03cf405d838a3cc3f712ea6faf942581a72c9284ff"}
